items.markdown:
`UK planning approval rates average around 81% nationally` . District authorities in England handle hundreds of thousands of applications annually, granting roughly 87% to 88% of determined district-level cases, with average decision timelines hovering around 60 days. Official statistics are tracked via [GOV.UK Planning Statistics](https://www.gov.uk/government/statistical-data-sets/live-tables-on-planning-application-statistics).[[1]](https://searchland.co.uk/blog/uk-planning-application-approval-rates)[[2]](https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/planning-applications-in-england-april-to-june-2025/planning-applications-in-england-april-to-june-2025-statistical-release)[[3]](https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/planning-applications-in-england-july-to-september-2025/planning-applications-in-england-july-to-september-2025-statistical-release)[[4]](https://www.gov.uk/government/statistical-data-sets/live-tables-on-planning-application-statistics)[[5]](https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/housing/articles/coronavirusandhousingindicatorsinenglandandwales/2020-07-02)National Statistics Overview

- **Approval Rate:** ~81% overall across recent years (ranging higher for minor/householder adjustments).
- **Volume:** Over 680,000 total applications submitted across recent annual cycles.
- **Timelines:** Average turnaround takes about 60 days, while major applications designated within agreed statutory periods take up to 13 weeks or longer extensions.[](https://searchland.co.uk/blog/uk-planning-application-approval-rates) [[1]](https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/planning-applications-in-england-october-to-december-2025/planning-applications-in-england-october-to-december-2025-statistical-release)[[2]](https://architectureforlondon.com/news/how-long-does-planning-permission-take/)[[3]](https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/planning-applications-in-england-april-to-june-2024/planning-applications-in-england-april-to-june-2024-statistical-release)

Key Data Sources

- **Central Government:** Access official regional tables through GOV.UK Planning Statistics for district and county returns.
- **Submission Trends:** Use the [Planning Portal Application Index](https://www.planningportal.co.uk/services/professional-portal/planning-portal-application-index/) for real-time tracking of initial proposals across England and Wales.
- **Commercial Datasets:** Platforms like [Searchland Data APIs](https://searchland.co.uk/our-apis/planning-applications) offer granular, map-integrated historical decisions and regional filters back to 1990.[](https://www.gov.uk/government/statistical-data-sets/live-tables-on-planning-application-statistics) [[1]](https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/planning-applications-in-england-january-to-march-2026/planning-applications-in-england-january-to-march-2026-technical-notes)[[2]](https://www.planningportal.co.uk/services/professional-portal/planning-portal-application-index/)[[3]](https://searchland.co.uk/our-apis/planning-applications)[[4]](https://www.ons.gov.uk/aboutus/whatwedo/programmesandprojects/economicstatisticstransformation/theplanforonseconomicstatistics)

Would you like this data broken down by a **specific region (like London or a specific council)** , or are you looking for statistics on a **particular type of development** (residential vs. commercial)?
